wider_tech.title: _for-sale DNS records
wider_tech.summary: _for-sale is a reserved DNS leaf node name, defined by RFC 10023 (Informational, July 2026) and registered with IANA. A TXT record published at _for-sale.example.com signals that example.com , although registered and resolving normally, is available for purchase. This site does not ship a _for-sale record: specification.website is not for sale. (386 points, 142 comments on Hacker News)
